Effort.description: A reasoning-effort level on the wire. Mirrors `bridge_core::delegation::Effort` variant for variant; a mirror test in bridge-core keeps the two from drifting.

ReviewPostMode.description: Whether findings wait for triage or post as soon as they are drafted.

oneOf.description: Findings land in the pane; nothing reaches GitHub until a person posts.
Bridge posts the review as soon as it is drafted.

ReviewerHarnessSettings.description: What the GitHub pull-request reviewer runs as on one harness. `None` falls through to the Reviewer model profile, then the harness default.

ReviewerSettings.description:
Global settings for the subagent that reviews pull requests from the GitHub pane: per-harness model and effort, and the instructions it is given. One record, not per workspace — a reviewer's shape is a preference about the reviewer, not about the repository.

Every field has a default, so a record stored before a field existed loads with that field's default.

defaultHarnesses.description: The harnesses a review runs on when the caller names none. Empty means the first available of Claude, Codex and OpenCode.

fallbackHarnesses.description: Tried in order when a pass's harness fails (sign-in, usage limit, crash). Empty means a failed harness fails the review.

postMode.description: Draft first (the default) or post as soon as findings are drafted.

systemPrompt.description: Empty means Bridge's default review instructions. `{number}` expands to the pull request number.

description: The stored reviewer settings beside the default prompt they replace, so a client can show the text an empty prompt stands for.
